**Summary of findings:**
- **Resource footprint:** 80.6 MB Docker image; ~50–150 MB RSS in practice (118 MiB measured on a live TrueNAS instance). Lean vs Homarr (200–600 MB). Docker socket access should use Tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy for least-privilege.
- **Auth model:** Zero native auth by design and permanently; single shared view means no per-user ACLs. `HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS` is mandatory since v1.0 for all non-localhost URLs. Forward auth via Authentik (⭐ 21.8k) or Authelia (⭐ 28k) is the recommended pattern.
- **Reverse-proxy fit:** Traefik (⭐ 63.6k) is the tightest fit via Docker labels + forward-auth middleware. Caddy (⭐ 73.2k) is simplest with built-in HTTPS and the `forward_auth` directive. nginx works with manual config. All three require WebSocket header passthrough (`Upgrade`/`Connection`) for real-time widget updates.
